description: This file defines a package 'types' that implements a label filtering system with parsing, tokenization, and evaluation functions, including support for logical operators, regex, and set operations.

classes.name: treeNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the label filter expression tree, used during parsing and evaluation.

methods.name: setRightNode
methods.description: Sets the right child node and updates parent reference.

methods.name: setLeftNode
methods.description: Sets the left child node and updates parent reference.

methods.name: firstAncestorWithPrecedenceLEQ
methods.description: Finds the first ancestor node with precedence less than or equal to given precedence.

methods.name: firstUnmatchedOpenNode
methods.description: Finds the first unmatched open group node in the tree.

methods.name: constructLabelFilter
methods.description: Constructs a LabelFilter function from the parse tree node.

methods.name: tokenString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token and its value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the tree with indentation.
